# ACP Registry snapshot

This reduced snapshot of agent names, websites, and launch metadata comes
from the [ACP Registry](https://github.com/agentclientprotocol/registry),
retrieved on 2026-11-17. It provides offline first-run discovery. Coincide
also refreshes the live registry in the background. The registry is distributed
under the Apache License, Version 2.0; see the accompanying `LICENSE`.

Coincide also bundles the registry's agent icons under
`crates/coincide-desktop/assets/agent-registry` for offline display. Those
marks identify their respective owners and do not imply endorsement. New
registry entries can load their official icons from the registry source.
The DeepSeek Harness mark comes from the official DeepSeek Harness repository
under its MIT license, retained beside that icon as `LICENSE-deepseek`.
